A roast beef sandwich dipped in its own broth, served in a dark wood room that has not
changed its mind since 1938. Order it double-dipped, get the gravy on the side anyway, and
do not plan anything ambitious afterwards.

[Double-dipped roast beef]{.chip-out} [Since 1938]{.chip-out}
